name: automata-project-v2
description: Smart Vending Machine Mealy and Moore FSM Simulator with Interactive Visuals & Full Automata Backend

scripts.install:all: cd backend && pnpm install && cd "../Vending Machine FSM Simulator Frontend" && pnpm install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'Vending Machine FSM Simulator Frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd "Vending Machine FSM Simulator Frontend" && pnpm dev
scripts.build: cd backend && pnpm build && cd "../Vending Machine FSM Simulator Frontend" && pnpm build
scripts.build:frontend: cd "Vending Machine FSM Simulator Frontend" && pnpm build
scripts.test: cd backend && npx tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts && cd "../Vending Machine FSM Simulator Frontend" && node --test src/fsm.test.ts
scripts.test:frontend: cd "Vending Machine FSM Simulator Frontend" && node --test src/fsm.test.ts
